title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Citywide First/Last Mile (FLM)-Eligible Projects.
text:
[Council File 23-1244-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to Citywide First/Last Mile (FLM)-Eligible Projects.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Yaroslavsky – Padilla et al.):
INSTRUCT the Bureau of Street Services, Bureau of Street Lighting, Bureau of Engineering, and Los Angeles Department of Transportation, in consultation with the City Administrative Officer (CAO) to jointly report to Council in 30 days with a report to include:
A multiyear capital delivery framework for FLM projects around eligible rail stations in the City
Priority projects, in coordination with the relevant Council Districts, adjacent to eligible rail stations while maximizing the City's ability to deliver all scope elements identified in the Metro First/Last Mile plans.
A multi-year staffing plan that scales up relative to project implementation and extends beyond the conclusion of the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games
An analysis of the need for additional funding outside of the 3 percent requirement, and to report with a blended funding strategy that assumes the City will meet 100 percent of its obligation through FLM project delivery, including but not limited to:
Grants
Measure M Sub-region allocations
The 3 percent Measure M local return
Report on any completed or in-progress projects that were intended to count towards the City's 3 percent requirement.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For, if amended:
United Neighborhoods Neighborhood Council
summary: City motion to advance First/Last Mile-Eligible Projects for transit connections.
